title: Kenyan Coconut Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kenyan-inspired curry dish featuring coconut milk, jazzy spices, and tender coconut meat.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the curry powder and jazzy spice blend, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the shredded coconut and sauté for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the curry with salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
